---
title: Code Filename (Code Block)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'quarto-code-filename\('
          - 'block\(width: 100%, radius: 2pt, clip: true, stroke: 0\.5pt \+ luma\(200\)\)'
        - []
---

    print("Hello, world!")
